description: This PHP class 'Headers' encapsulates HTTP header operations such as marshalling, unmarshalling, and managing header entries within the AWS CRT HTTP namespace.

classes.name: Headers
classes.description: A class representing HTTP headers with functionality to encode, decode, and manage headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Headers object with an optional array of headers.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes headers into a string buffer using Encoding functions.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes a buffer into a Headers object by reading strings and reconstructing headers.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of headers stored.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified header.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates the value of a specified header.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the internal headers as an associative array.
